question: In a certain code language, 'TRAIN' is coded as ‘14911820' and 'POLIT' is coded as ‘209121516'. How will 'SHNKE' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'TRAIN' is coded as ‘14911820'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb14981d5dbc77467b77ea2f988709ebfc09d0abf67aa6c1bed400346cf4997.png] 

'POLIT' is coded as ‘209121516'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3172632133ccb14e494cfb805e715c89a12ae2b62575301592b789efce945e30.png] 

Similarly, for 'SHNKE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a923fdfa52a7c67b40eaed3cae70ed659245066441a18dc33f932e27230d136.png] 

So, 'SHNKE' will be coded as '51114819'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
